messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: greedy maximal-packing via simulated annealing on area minima

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A greedy maximal-packing via simulated annealing on area minima converges to a configuration whose smallest triangle area equals (5 - sqrt(5))/32 ≈ 0.0886, with four points at the corners of the unit square, four points at coordinates (1/2, (5±sqrt(5))/10) and ((5±sqrt(5))/10, 1/2), and five points forming a regular pentagon inscribed in the central disk of radius 1/(2phi) centered at (1/2, 1/2). The regular pentagonal symmetry of the interior cluster is the unique arrangement that maximizes the minimum area among all 286 triangles, and any perturbation of a vertex by epsilon > 0 creates a triangle of area below (5 - sqrt(5))/32."}
